2026-07-01.title: Shibata City Day Trip + Otakusen Ceremony

haneda.name: Haneda Airport (International Terminal)
haneda.description: Arrive in Japan; immigration via Visit Japan Web KIOSK + baggage claim + Suica card exchange

tabinos-hamamatsucho.name: Hotel Tabinos Hamamatsucho
tabinos-hamamatsucho.description: Directly connected to Takeiba Stn (Yurikamome); modern design; best Haneda access (10 min); check-in + rest

divercity-evening.name: DiverCity Dinner + Flexible Evening
divercity-evening.description: Takeiba→Aomi (10 min)→DiverCity; dinner 18:00–20:00; if energized: Gundam Night Show (20:00) + Aqua Symphony (20:30); if tired: return hotel; DiverCity Official

gundam-night-optional-26.name: Unicorn Gundam Night Show (6/26 Optional)
gundam-night-optional-26.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE (retires Aug 2026)! [Optional] Free; every 30 min from 19:00; Official Site

aqua-symphony-optional-26.name: Tokyo Aqua Symphony (6/26 Optional)
aqua-symphony-optional-26.description: [Optional] Free; Odaiba Marine Park; 15–20 min walk from DiverCity; 10-min fountain show; 20:00 or 21:00 show; Official Site

hotel-breakfast.name: Hotel Tabinos Breakfast
hotel-breakfast.description: Restaurant connected to Takeiba Station; fuel up for the full day

movement-to-ariake.name: Takeiba → Ariake Tennos-no-Mori (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; Takeiba→Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; ~15–20 min

small-worlds.name: 🎮 SMALL WORLDS TOKYO
small-worlds.description: [Must-do] World's largest miniature theme park; 3 min from Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; 2.5–3 hrs; or swap with Tokyo Dream Park Doraemon exhibition; Official Site

movement-to-ichiba-mae.name: Ariake → Ichiba-mae (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ichiba-mae.description: Yurikamome Line; very short ~5 min; direct to Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara

toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.name: 🍱 Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara
toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.description: [Must-do] Gourmet food hall at Toyosu Market waterfront complex; seafood bowls, soba, ramen, BBQ; ~1.5 hr dining; Official Site

movement-back-to-ariake.name: Ichiba-mae → Ariake (Yurikamome)
movement-back-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; ~5 min return after lunch

tokyo-dream-park.name: 🎡 Tokyo Dream Park
tokyo-dream-park.description: [Must-do] Ariake; 6F rooftop plaza + Shohei Ohtani golden statue FREE; 100% Doraemon Exhibition ¥2,400 (weekend pre-sale, optional); 2–3 hrs; Official Site

movement-to-odaiba.name: Ariake → Aomi (Yurikamome)
movement-to-odaiba.description: Yurikamome Line; ~15 min to DiverCity area

divercity-afternoon.name: 🎮 DiverCity Afternoon (Flexible)
divercity-afternoon.description: Choose freely: ✅ Unko Museum (1–1.5h) ✅ Gundam Base Tokyo 5F (free) ✅ Unicorn Gundam statue photo ✅ Shopping & café; ✅ Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12): collect at DiverCity 2F + 5 other Odaiba spots → instant on-site lottery machine (win = collect prize right there, tourist-friendly!); DiverCity Official

divercity-dinner.name: 🍽️ DiverCity Dinner
divercity-dinner.description: Wide range of restaurants inside the mall; dine as the Gundam transitions from day to night lighting

gundam-night.name: 🌃 Unicorn Gundam Night Show
gundam-night.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE — retiring end of August 2026 after nearly 9 years! Free; WALL-G shows every 30 min (19:00–21:30): 19:00 Gundam 45th Anniversary Special Movie · 20:00 UNICORN Special Movie · 21:30 GUNDAM:BEYOND; recommended: 20:00 show; Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12) at DiverCity 2F — collect for chance to win limited RG Gundam; Official Site

movement-to-odaiba-bay.name: Aomi → Odaiba Marine Park (walk)
movement-to-odaiba-bay.description: 15–20 min walk behind DiverCity; scenic Tokyo Bay views along the way

aqua-symphony.name: 💦 Tokyo Aqua Symphony Night Fountain Show
aqua-symphony.description: Free; 3 min from Odaiba Stn; 10 shows/day (11–21:00, no 16:00); recommended 21:00 show; ~10 min; Official Site

movement-return-to-hotel.name: Odaiba → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-to-hotel.description: Yurikamome Line; Odaiba→Takeiba; ~20 min; return to Hotel Tabinos to rest

hotel-breakfast-28.name: Hotel Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-28.description: Restaurant at Takeiba Station; fuel up for a full day in Harajuku + Shinjuku

movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.name: Takeiba → Sangubashi (transit)
movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.description: JR Yamanote Line northbound; ~30 min; heading to Meiji Shrine north entrance

movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.name: Sangubashi → Meiji Shrine North Gate (walk)
movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.description: Walk ~30 min through greenery to the north entrance

harajuku-meiji-shrine.name: ⛩️ Meiji Shrine – Forest Walk
harajuku-meiji-shrine.description: Japan's most important Shinto shrine; free; enter north gate, exit east; serene forested path; tranquil contrast to the city; Official Site

harajuku-omotesando.name: 🚶 Omotesando (表參道)
harajuku-omotesando.description: Tokyo's premier upscale shopping street; LV, Gucci, Prada flagships; beautiful architecture; connects directly from Meiji Shrine east exit

movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.name: Omotesando → Takeshita-dori (walk)
movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.description: 10–15 min walk; Omotesando area straight to Takeshita-dori entrance

harajuku-takeshita.name: 🚶 Takeshita-dori – 1.5 hrs
harajuku-takeshita.description: World-famous Harajuku youth fashion street; H&M, Forever 21, Japanese indie shops, crepes, accessories; lively crowds; full 1.5 hrs to snack & explore; Info

harajuku-kawaii-land.name: 💗 Kawaii Land Kyun Kyun [Highlight]
harajuku-kawaii-land.description: Cute small-animal petting park (FLEG Harajuku B1); 1-hr time limit (peak season); interact with rabbits, guinea pigs, hedgehogs & hamsters; pre-book required: Official Site

movement-takeshita-to-shinjuku3.name: Harajuku → Shinjuku (transit)
movement-takeshita-to-shinjuku3.description: Fukutoshin Line Meiji-Jingumae→Shinjuku-Sanchome (~4 min) + walk; ~30 min total to Kabukicho area

hanazono-shrine.name: ⛩️ Hanazono Shrine + Kabukicho Ichibangai Arch
hanazono-shrine.description: Shinjuku's guardian shrine (5-17-3 Shinjuku); free; quick visit & photo; then a short walk to the iconic orange Kabukicho Ichibangai arch; both free; Hanazono Shrine / Kabukicho Ichibangai

ninja-trick-house.name: 🥷 Ninja Trick House [Optional]
ninja-trick-house.description: 4F, 2-28-13 Kabukicho; shuriken throwing, ninja experience, trick room; last entry 17:00 (15:00 entry ✅); closed Tue/Wed; skip if tired → extend Tokyu Tower time; Official Site

i-love-kabukicho-godzilla.name: 📸 I LOVE Kabukicho + Godzilla Head (quick photo)
i-love-kabukicho-godzilla.description: I❤KABUKI-CHO sign (Hayashi Building 1-14-7) + Godzilla Head on Toho Building 8F terrace; two iconic Kabukicho photo spots; within 5 min walk; both free; I LOVE Kabukicho · Toho Official

tokyu-kabukicho-tower.name: 🎡 Tokyu Kabukicho Tower
tokyu-kabukicho-tower.description: 48-storey mixed-use landmark; namco TOKYO (3–6F) arcade & amusements; Zepp Shinjuku, spa, restaurants; freely explore for 1.5 hrs; Official Site

shinjuku-takashimaya.name: 🛍️ Shinjuku Takashimaya (1 hr)
shinjuku-takashimaya.description: Shinjuku-Sanchome; upscale department store; international brands, cosmetics, depachika basement food hall; 1 hr shopping; ⚠️ closes 19:30; 17:45 entry = ample time; Official Site

shinjuku-dinner.name: 🍜 Ganso Aburado Kabukicho (Dinner)
shinjuku-dinner.description: Abura soba (brothless ramen) specialty; 1-4-8 Kabukicho; 1 min walk from Godzilla Head; open 11:00–5:00am; Official Site

shinjuku-golden-gai.name: 🏮 Shinjuku Golden Gai (Evening Walk)
shinjuku-golden-gai.description: Six narrow alleys next to Kabukicho; ~200 tiny intimate bars; WWII-era wooden buildings preserved to this day; magical at night; free to stroll & photograph; Official Site

movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.name: Shinjuku → Tochomae (transit)
movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.description: Marunouchi Line Shinjuku-Sanchome→Tochomae (~5 min); or walk ~12 min; must arrive by 20:00

tokyo-night-light-projection.name: ✨ Tokyo Night Light – Shinjuku Projection Mapping Show [Must-see]
tokyo-night-light-projection.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building (connected to Tochomae Stn); massive outdoor projection mapping show; every night 20:00–21:00 (confirm before going); free; breathtaking light art; Official Site

movement-return-hotel-28.name: Tochomae → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-hotel-28.description: Marunouchi Line; ~25 min; return to Hotel Tabinos; rest up for early Shinkansen

hotel-breakfast-29.name: Hotel Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-29.description: Restaurant at Takeiba Station; fuel up before teamLab

movement-hotel-to-teamlab.name: Takeiba → teamLab Borderless (transit)
movement-hotel-to-teamlab.description: Marunouchi Line Takeiba→Akasaka-Mitsuke (~5 min) + 10 min walk to Azabudai Hills

teamlab-29.name: 🎨 teamLab Borderless – Azabudai Hills [Highlight]
teamlab-29.description: [Must-do] Boundary-less immersive digital art; interconnected rooms; light & interactive installations; 3 hrs recommended; must pre-book online; Book Tickets

azabudai-optional-shrines.name: ⛩️ Azabudai Shrines [Optional]
azabudai-optional-shrines.description: [Flexible] After teamLab: if time & energy → quick photo at Reiyukai Shakaden + Nishikubo Hachimangu (15 min); rushed/tired → skip, head to Tokyo Stn

movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.name: Azabudai → Echigo-Yuzawa (Shinkansen)
movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.description: Marunouchi Line Akasaka-Mitsuke→Tokyo Stn (~15 min) + walk to Shinkansen; Joetsu Shinkansen Tokyo→Echigo-Yuzawa 13:00–14:00; pre-book reserved seats (ekinet); enjoy ekiben on board

yuzawa-arrival.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Arrival + Onsen
yuzawa-arrival.description: Explore around the station; hotel hot spring bath; foot bath; cafés; enjoy the resort atmosphere; recharge before dinner

yuzawa-hotel.name: 湯沢グランドホテル (Yuzawa Grand Hotel)
yuzawa-hotel.description: 3 min walk from station; large communal onsen bath + outdoor bath; all-you-can-eat dinner & breakfast (Japanese/Western/Chinese); free luggage storage for 6/30 Kiyotsu trip; Official Site

yuzawa-checkout.name: Hotel Checkout + Luggage Storage
yuzawa-checkout.description: Early checkout; hotel offers free luggage storage; check out and head to Kiyotsu Gorge

movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.name: Yuzawa → Kiyotsu Gorge (bus)
movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.description: Express bus; 3 min walk from station; ~30 min; alight at Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel stop

kiyotsu-gorge-morning.name: 🏞️ Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel ～Mirror Reflection～ [Highlight]
kiyotsu-gorge-morning.description: One of Japan's three great gorges; 750m observation tunnel with stunning 'water mirror' art installation at the far end (best on sunny days); ~1.5 hrs; arrive early for fewer crowds; Official Site

yuzawa-lunch-rest.name: 🍱 Yuzawa Lunch + Onsen Break
yuzawa-lunch-rest.description: Around Yuzawa Station; try onigiri bomb (bakudan onigiri) or foot bath at HATAGO Isen; enjoy the resort vibe before Shinkansen departure

movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.name: Yuzawa → Niigata (Shinkansen)
movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.description: Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa→Niigata; ~45 min; pre-book reserved seat; enjoy ekiben (station bento) on board

niigata-arrival-rest.name: Niigata Station Arrival + Rest
niigata-arrival-rest.description: Store bags at coin lockers or hotel; relax at station mall Popia Bandai or a café; recharge for the afternoon

niigata-hotel-checkin.name: Niigata Hotel Check-in
niigata-hotel-checkin.description: Check in; rest and freshen up before evening festival activities

niigata-afternoon-activities.name: Niigata City Afternoon
niigata-afternoon-activities.description: Explore Niigata city; local food, shopping around Bandai area or Furumachi Arcade; enjoy the relaxed pace of Niigata

kahara-shrine-first-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Festival Opening Night
kahara-shrine-first-night.description: Kanbara Matsuri (蒲原まつり) opening night; traditional Niigata summer festival dating back 300+ years; stalls, food, performances, mikoshi; free admission; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

zoushuukan.name: 蔵春閣 (Zoshunkan)
zoushuukan.description: Former Ito Hikohachi villa; elegant Meiji-era architecture; Japanese garden; Info

shimizu-en.name: 清水園 (Shimizu-en Garden)
shimizu-en.description: Traditional Japanese garden formerly attached to the Mizoguchi clan in Shibata; peaceful strolling garden; Official Site

shibata-castle.name: 新発田城 (Shibata Castle)
shibata-castle.description: Japan's 100 Famous Castles #17; unique three-shachi (dolphin-fish) golden turrets; free exterior; restored buildings; Official Site

senbei-kingdom.name: せんべい王国 (Senbei Kingdom)
senbei-kingdom.description: Free admission; draw & paint your own giant rice cracker + flavoring (weekdays, reservation required); fun hands-on experience; Official Site

otakusen-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Bandai Taiko + Otakusen Ceremony
otakusen-night.description: 18:30 ★ Bandai Taiko (thunderous drum performance) → 19:00 ★ Otakusen (830-year-old Shinto ritual at Kanbara Shrine Kagura-den; free to watch); festival stalls open late; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

kahara-final.name: Kanbara Festival – Final Day
kahara-final.description: Final day; stalls, Great Daikoku dance offering (15:00); Bandai Taiko already watched on night of 7/1 — depart for Tokyo after Daikoku; free; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

niigata-haneda-transit.name: Niigata → Tokyo (Shinkansen)
niigata-haneda-transit.description: Joetsu Shinkansen toward Tokyo; ~100 min; arrive early evening with plenty of time to check in and have dinner

ginza-hotel.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza – Check-in
ginza-hotel.description: 2-15-13 Tsukiji; arrive early evening — time to check in and enjoy dinner around Higashi-Ginza; Tsukiji market and Day 7 sights nearby; Official Site

tsukiji-market.name: Tsukiji Outer Market (築地場外市場)
tsukiji-market.description: Breakfast recommended; 5 min walk; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; morning = freshest produce and best atmosphere; Official Site

tsukiji-honganji.name: Tsukiji Honganji Temple
tsukiji-honganji.description: 10 min walk; free; striking Indian-style Buddhist architecture; beautiful in morning light

kabuki-za.name: Kabuki-za Theatre – Curtain-View Seat (幕見席)
kabuki-za.description: Traditional Kabuki; 4F single-act seating; Kuruwa Sanbaso (ceremonial dance, ~17 min); English audio guide available ¥1,000/unit; book online day before at 12:00; Book Here

senso-ji.name: Senso-ji Temple, Kaminarimon & Nakamise
senso-ji.description: Tokyo's most visited temple; free; iconic Kaminarimon thunder gate; Nakamise shopping street; morning = fewer crowds; Official Site

higashi-hongan-ji.name: Higashi Hongan-ji (Asakusa)
higashi-hongan-ji.description: Free; West Asakusa 1-5-5; 5 min walk from Senso-ji; peaceful alternative temple worth a quick visit; Official Site

samurai-ninja.name: Samurai Ninja Museum Asakusa
samurai-ninja.description: English-guided tour; armour wearing + shuriken throwing; ~60 min; 3 min walk from Higashi Hongan-ji; pre-book online; Book Online

kappabashi-tanabata.name: 🎋 Kappabashi – Shitamachi Tanabata Festival
kappabashi-tanabata.description: Bamboo Tanabata decorations, food stalls; 1.2km from Showa-dori to Kokusai-dori; 5 min from Samurai Ninja Museum; free strolling; Asakusa Tourism / Official Site / ▶ YouTube

movement-asakusa-to-hotel.name: Asakusa → Hotel (Higashi-Ginza) [transit]
movement-asakusa-to-hotel.description: Hibiya Line Asakusa→Higashi-Ginza; ~20 min; early return to prep for next day

hotel-rest-evening-3.name: Hotel Rest + Dinner + Early Sleep
hotel-rest-evening-3.description: Return to Via Inn Higashi-Ginza; rest, pack bags; dinner 17:30–19:00; early sleep to be fresh for Akihabara day

tsukiji-market-morning.name: Tsukiji Market (Quick Breakfast)
tsukiji-market-morning.description: Quick breakfast before checkout; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; Official Site

hotel-checkout-4.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza – Checkout + Luggage Storage
hotel-checkout-4.description: Check out; leave luggage with hotel storage; complete by 10:00

akihabara-lunch-afternoon.name: ★ Akihabara Lunch + Area Explore
akihabara-lunch-afternoon.description: Enter Akihabara; lunch choice (ramen, teishoku, conveyor sushi); first explore of the electronics district

akiba-fukurou-owl-cafe-4.name: 🦉 Akiba Fukurou Owl Cafe
akiba-fukurou-owl-cafe-4.description: Owl interaction experience; must pre-book; cash only; cute owls, photos, food & drink; 1-hr session in Akihabara; Info

akihabara-afternoon-shopping.name: Akihabara Shopping & Exploring
akihabara-afternoon-shopping.description: After Owl Cafe; browse electronics street, game arcades, figure shops, anime goods; classic Akihabara experience

movement-akiba-to-minato.name: Akihabara → Minatomirai (transit)
movement-akiba-to-minato.description: Hibiya Line Akihabara→Higashi-Ginza (collect luggage) → JR to Yokohama direction; ~50 min total; heading to Aka-Renga

minato-light-meal-rest.name: Minatomirai – Light Meal & Rest
minato-light-meal-rest.description: Brief rest after arriving in Minatomirai; light snack or meal to recharge

akarenga.name: 赤レンガ倉庫 (Red Brick Warehouse) + Harbour Walk
akarenga.description: Free; photogenic Meiji-era red brick warehouses; Yokohama harbour scenery; beautiful in late afternoon light; Official Site

movement-minato-to-shinyoko.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (transit)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~20 min; check in at Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama on arrival

shinyoko-hotel.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Check-in
shinyoko-hotel.description: Natural hot spring bath; free breakfast; 10–12 min walk to Nissan Stadium; check in, rest, freshen up

movement-hotel-to-stadium.name: Hotel → Nissan Stadium (walk)
movement-hotel-to-stadium.description: 10–12 min walk; arrive early to queue for merchandise; bring towel, water, sunscreen (outdoor venue)

ado-1.name: Ado Concert – Night 1 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-1.description: Nissan Stadium (~72,000 capacity); large outdoor concert; tickets confirmed; wait 30–45 min after show before leaving (crowd management)

yamashita-park.name: 山下公園 (Yamashita Park)
yamashita-park.description: Free; panoramic Yokohama Harbour views; seaside promenade; stroll and take photos

osaka-daisan-bashi.name: 大さん橋 (Osanbashi – Yokohama International Pier)
osaka-daisan-bashi.description: Free; Yokohama International Cruise Terminal; dramatic curved wooden rooftop terrace with sweeping harbour views; one of Yokohama's most beautiful spots

motomachi.name: 元町ショッピングストリート (Motomachi)
motomachi.description: Yokohama's historic upscale shopping street; stylish boutiques, cafés, pastry shops; foreign settlement atmosphere

cup-noodles.name: カップヌードルミュージアム (Cup Noodles Museum)
cup-noodles.description: Hands-on food museum; create your own original Cup Noodle flavour; Chicken Ramen factory workshop; fun for all ages; Official Site
cup-noodles.price: Adult ¥500 · Under 12 free; Custom Cup Noodle +¥500; Chicken Ramen workshop +¥500

air-cabin.name: YOKOHAMA AIR CABIN
air-cabin.description: Cable car ride over the canal; Unga Park Stn → Sakuragi-cho Stn; ~5 min scenic aerial ride

bandai-namco-cross-store.name: 🎮 Bandai Namco Cross Store Yokohama
bandai-namco-cross-store.description: Yokohama World Porters 2F; 1 min from Unga Park Stn; 20+ official shops (Gundam, JoJo, etc.); Gashapon corner; amusement area; free entry; Official Site

movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (return)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~25 min; return to hotel; rest up for Night 2 concert

ado-2.name: Ado Concert – Night 2 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-2.description: Nissan Stadium; tickets confirmed; wait after show; prepare for tomorrow's checkout

shinyoko-checkout.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Early Checkout
shinyoko-checkout.description: Early checkout; pack luggage; heading to Kawasaki Daishi

haneda-luggage.name: Haneda Airport – Luggage Storage
haneda-luggage.description: Storage at any terminal; collect before departure

kawasaki-daishi.name: 川崎大師 Kawasaki Daishi (Heiken-ji Temple)
kawasaki-daishi.description: Founded 1128; one of Japan's top 3 most-visited temples; worship + Nakamise-dori shopping approach; traditional sweets and crafts; Info

nakamise-dori.name: 仲見世通り (Nakamise Shopping Street)
nakamise-dori.description: Temple approach shopping street; traditional crafts, souvenirs, food; last Japan shopping before departure

kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.name: 📸 Kawasaki Daishi – Yakuyoke-mon Gate (大山門)
kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.description: Iconic vermillion main gate at the Nakamise-dori entrance; symbol of Kawasaki Daishi; quick photo stop only; free

haneda-return.name: Haneda Airport – International Departure
haneda-return.description: Collect luggage + duty-free shopping + check-in + immigration; arrive at airport by 13:30
